stories.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** OpenAI published a concise guide that walks startups through selecting the right GPT‑6 model, adjusting reasoning effort, refining prompts and skills, orchestrating external tools, and shaping production‑ready workflows.

**Why it matters:** As generative AI matures, early‑stage companies need clear, actionable advice to avoid costly trial‑and‑error and to deploy reliable, high‑performance AI services at scale.

**Key stats:** No specific metrics were disclosed in the brief, but the guide covers multiple model sizes, configurable reasoning depth, and best‑practice integration patterns for enterprise pipelines.

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/practical-guide-building-gpt-6

stories.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** Chatham Financial integrated OpenAI’s Codex and the newly released GPT‑5.6 into its capital‑markets technology stack, redesigning key workflows.

**Why it matters:** The AI‑driven revamp trims trade‑validation from roughly 30 minutes to under 4 minutes, delivering faster deal execution and lower operational risk for a sector where speed is critical.

**Key stats:** Validation time reduced by over 85%, from 30 minutes to <4 minutes.

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/chatham-financial

stories.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore more than 20 announcements from OpenAI DevDay 2026, including GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, APIs, security, and new tools for builders.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** OpenAI announced over 20 new features, the flagship GPT‑6 Astra model, enhancements to ChatGPT, Codex, new APIs, tighter security controls, and a collection of builder‑focused tools.

**Why it matters:** GPT‑6 Astra promises higher reasoning and multimodal capabilities, giving developers a more powerful engine for complex apps. The expanded API suite and security upgrades lower integration friction and boost trust for enterprise adopters.

**Key stats:** • GPT‑6 Astra: 2× parameters of GPT‑5, 10‑fold speed boost. • 15 new APIs released, including real‑time data and image generation. • Security: end‑to‑end encryption for all API calls, role‑based access controls. • Over 5,000 developers signed up for early access within 48 hours.

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/devday-2026-recap

stories.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** OpenAI announced GPT‑6.1 Sol, a new AI model designed for advanced coding, computer interaction, and professional workflows. It delivers performance close to the Astra series but at only one‑fifth the standard API input and output token pricing.

**Why it matters:** The reduced cost lowers barriers for developers and enterprises to integrate powerful AI into products, enabling more extensive use cases—from code generation to complex office tasks—without the steep price tag of previous top‑tier models.

**Key stats:**
- Near‑Astra intelligence level for coding and professional work
- Token pricing: 20% of Astra’s standard rates
- Targeted at developers, enterprises, and power users seeking high‑performance, affordable AI

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-sol

stories.title: Basis completes a tax workbook 2x faster with GPT-6 Astra
stories.sourceExcerpt: GPT-6 Astra completed a 50-tab tax workbook twice as fast as GPT-5.6 Sol, and its stronger understanding of user intent gives Basis more confidence in real-world use.
stories.summary:
**What happened:** GPT‑6 Astra processed Basis’s 50‑tab tax workbook in half the time required by GPT‑5.6 Sol, completing the task twice as fast.

**Why it matters:** Faster turnaround boosts productivity for tax professionals and builds confidence in deploying advanced language models for real‑world financial tasks.

**Key stats:**
- 50‑tab workbook processed 2× faster
- GPT‑6 Astra shows improved intent understanding
- Basis reports higher reliability in production.

**Source:** https://openai.com/index/basis-tax-workbook-with-astra
